fields.title: Show Ui On Interaction
fields.description: Determines whether interacting with this block opens its container UI. Defaults to true. When false, normal block interaction events can run instead.

fields.title: Slot Count
fields.description: Sets the number of slots in the container.

fields.title: Title
fields.description: Optional container title, stored as a language file key or raw text. Must be nonempty and at most 256 characters.
